[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
For the most part this week, all pollutants will remain stable. The main thing to highlight will be the potential for locally elevated levels of PM10 (dust) and PM

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today and tomorrow, a temperature inversion will confine pollutants near the surface early each day. However, as surface high pressure persists to the northeast, light northwesterly to northeasterly winds will aid pollutant dispersion each afternoon. As a result, AQI levels will be low-Moderate on T
